shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/power/pipes, linked weather, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH and VEF PipeSystem support as SOFT compat (ModsConfig-gated, compile-only references, JIT-safe isolation: no foreign types in class-level members of gated classes).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics.
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync, weather, power, pipes); fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (T0-T3 signed off; T4a/T4b coded)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; loss-proof StairTransfer; PageUp/PageDown level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, lit face rows, fogged core, guaranteed mining reveal.
- See-below renderer: WHITELISTED content layers only (overlays of any origin cannot cross levels); air-cells light mask; live dynamic things below; far clip 70.
- Weather link every 150 ticks. Live sync via MapEvents (rooftop coupling, floor-to-roof, fall-through).
- Cross-level work, idle return, drafted gizmos, colony-wide tables.
- Cross-level hauling (storage + construction demand, quantity-aware pinning, right-click orders); needs (bed redirect); one-colony resource counts.
- Power across levels (T4a): stairwells transmit power and bridge nets (damped surplus-to-deficit, master side per pair, 30-tick cadence).
- Pipe networks (T4b): ground map's LevelComp walks stairwell pairs every 250 ticks. DBH: same-NetType plumbing nets touching the stair cell on both levels equalize tower water via PullWater/PushWater (sewage still needs per-level handling: septic or outlet). VEF PipeSystem: same-PipeNetDef nets touching the stair cell equalize stored resource via DrawAmongStorage/DistributeAmongStorage (each level needs at least one storage). Both damped 0.5 with leftover return, settings toggle, pipes kill switch. Zero cost when neither mod is active.

## Quadruple pass log
T4b: soft-ref isolation audited (foreign types only in gated method bodies; static-field violation caught and fixed); equalization uses only public framework APIs; framework updates degrade to a single logged kill-switch trip. Confidence: DBH bridge 80%, VEF bridge 85%, isolation 90%, wiring 92%. T4a power bridge 82% still awaiting live verification.
Known gaps: DBH sewage per-level; VEF flow verification needs a consumer mod (none installed); bills cross-level fetch; renderer polish backlog.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T3 DONE. T4a+T4b CODE DONE (compat test pending: DBH + VEF as companions).
- T4c: temperature sync, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling.
- Publishing prep per global rules.

## Status
T4b compiled green, pushed. Next: companion compat run with Dubs Bad Hygiene + VEF loaded.
